name: Assemble
description: Turning placed blocks into a moving contraption, and back.

pages.title: Assemble
pages.text:
To **assemble** is to turn placed blocks into one moving contraption, train, ship or rocket. **Disassemble** turns it back into blocks.\
\
Glue decides what comes along. Movers like bearings assemble their own; trains use a Train Station's Assembly Mode, ships the Physics Assembler. Trains disassemble only at a station.
